necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness that have persisted despite initial management for supraventricular tachycardia, corresponding to diagnosis code I47.1. To further characterize the arrhythmia and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances, a long-term continuous ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247) is clinically indicated. This service is necessary to evaluate the ongoing symptoms and guide further treatment decisions.
